description: Issue a new invoice. A real fiscal document: it takes the next number in the series, and in Romania it is what gets reported to ANAF. Prices, quantities and rates are decimal STRINGS. Every line states vat_included. The buyer's CIF or CNP and IBAN are checked by their control digits. The company is the one in app.json; the input has no field for it. The answer carries computedTotal (exact, EN 16931 rounding), oblioTotal (the document read back, which must match) and the idempotency_key it was sent with. Moves money or makes a legal document: the client asks the user to approve each call.

autocomplete.description: Fill a Romanian company's details from its CIF. Oblio's default: no.

cif.description: CIF (RO prefix for a VAT payer) or, for a person, CNP; checked by its control digit unless country names another country.

code.description: The client's code in Oblio's client list.

iban.description: Checked by its own check digits.

name.description: The company's name, or the person's.

save.description: Update the saved client with these details. Oblio's default: no.

document_number.description: The payment's own reference, required for every type but Chitanta.

series_name.description: The receipt series, required for Chitanta.

contract_number.description: The contract reference, BT-12 on the e-Factura.

exchange_rate.description: Oblio's default: the rate in the company settings.

idempotency_key.description: Oblio refuses a second document with the same key. Leave it out: the key is then derived from the document's content and issue date, so an identical retry cannot issue twice. Give one only to issue a second, deliberately identical document the same day, or to retry with the key an outcome_unknown failure reported.

order_number.description: The buyer's order reference, BT-13 on the e-Factura.

management.description: The stock management (gestiune) goods leave from.

price.description: Unit price in the document's currency, as a decimal STRING ("1000.00"), never a number.

product_type.description: "Serviciu" for services; the rest need stock enabled.

quantity.description: Quantity, as a decimal STRING ("1000.00"), never a number.

save.description: Save this price as the product's list price. Oblio's default: yes.

vat_included.description: Whether `price` already includes VAT. Required: Oblio's own default (included) silently turns a net price into a gross one.

vat_name.description: The rate's name from list_vat_rates, "Normala" and so on.

vat_percentage.description: VAT rate in percent, 21 for 21%, as a decimal STRING ("1000.00"), never a number.

send_email.description: Oblio emails the document to the client (client.email, else the one saved in Oblio); the answer's emailedTo says where. Default: no.

series_name.description: A series from list_series, of the document's type.

use_stock.description: Take the goods out of stock, with stock enabled.

name: create_invoice
title: Issue an invoice
